style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.mm_dusk_of_the_dead: The clock tower of a village with its bell swinging, street lamps going out one by one in the dusk
pictures.mm_dusk_of_the_dead_2: Hunched figures in grave rags crouched over a body in a doorway, a moon like a crone's face above
pictures.mm_broken_gate: A tall iron fence of prison-bar pickets running off into fog, a gate hanging bent outward between two hooded iron reapers
pictures.mm_broken_gate_2: Thousands of grave markers climbing hills into blue-green mist, as far as the eye goes
pictures.mm_gravedigger_door: The great moss-grown sepulcher with huge double doors, an orc ghost hunched under a chained headstone and a black hound with white eyes both holding lanterns to the seam
pictures.mm_gravedigger_door_2: Mist tendrils writhing out of a crack in stone doors and burning away in azure lantern light, six iron sconces above, five of them dark
pictures.mm_beacon_lit: A brazier roaring up in coloured flame with kindling burning in it, mist rolling back across a graveyard
pictures.mm_beacon_lit_2: Far away, a sconce above great stone doors catching fire in the same colour, seen through fog
pictures.mm_isolde_fades: A black hound with white eyes alone at stone doors, her lantern guttering
pictures.mm_isolde_fades_2: A door seam with grey mist pouring out, a lantern lying on the steps
pictures.mm_penitent_pilgrim: A young orc seer leading a ritual in a stone circle, his clan gathered around him at night
pictures.mm_penitent_pilgrim_2: The same stone circle empty, ash and light streaming up into the sky, a lone figure dragging a huge stone of names down a long road
pictures.mm_six_beacons: The sepulcher doors framed by six coloured flames, crimson violet amber magenta emerald azure
pictures.mm_six_beacons_2: An orc ghost seen from behind before the doors, fainter and more hollow, his lantern smaller
pictures.mm_stygian_descent: A spiral stair whose walls are thousands of carved screaming faces, sconces burning sick blue-green
pictures.mm_stygian_descent_2: Stone doors carved with a hooded woman holding a lantern, at the end of a hall of wailing faces
pictures.mm_harrowing: A twenty-foot tear of churning mist above a hanging platform, an orc ghost translucent below it raising his lantern
pictures.mm_harrowing_2: A colossal hooded reaper with a scythe of blue-green fire and a gravestone on its back, skeletal eyes, chains falling from the dark
pictures.mm_azure_defiance: Flickers of azure light inside a colossal chained reaper, the mist lashing out
pictures.mm_azure_defiance_2: Five stone coffins glowing in five colours on raised platforms, in a cavern of blue-green fire
pictures.mm_tear_sealed: A lantern blazing white-blue until the frame washes out, a ring of mist collapsing into it
pictures.mm_tear_sealed_2: A calm cavern in azure light, the ceiling whole, no tear, an empty lantern on the floor
pictures.mm_isolde_farewell: A black hound at the sepulcher steps with a lantern in her mouth, looking toward the south-west
pictures.mm_isolde_farewell_2: The same hound sitting alone by the doors under six burning sconces
